item.title: Slippery and icy pavement caused by ongoing runoff from adjoining garden, 13th November
item.description:
A substantial section of the public pavement is becoming covered in wet mud, decaying vegetation and water, apparently due to ongoing runoff from the raised private garden behind the adjoining boundary wall. This is creating a significant slip hazard, particularly during freezing overnight temperatures when the wet pavement becomes icy. The affected area extends across much of the pavement width and appears to be a recurring problem rather than a one-off spillage. Please could the highways team investigate the source of the runoff and arrange for the pavement to be made safe? In particular, I would appreciate consideration of whether the adjoining property owner needs to take action to prevent water and debris from continuing to discharge onto the public highway.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Mackenzie Road, Anerley, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
